name: Stats
description: A row of figures with a short label each (years in business, clients, uptime), with an optional heading and intro. The counter/number section of a landing page; numbers are static text, not animated.

layout.description: grid: figures in columns. inline: one line that wraps, for two to four short figures.

columns.description: Figures per row on wide screens (grid layout); two on phones.

style.description: plain: figures on the section background. card: each figure in its own box. divided: a hairline at each figure's leading edge, no box.

align.description: Alignment of each figure and its label.

valueSize.description: The figure's size: md, lg, xl or a display-size number.

labelSize.description: The label under each figure: sm (small), base (body size) or lg (a counter title set like a subheading).

order.description: Which the page's text reads first, as the source does: label-first (an Elementor counter) or value-first (a Gutenberg figure heading over its label). The figure is drawn on top either way.

items.label: Figures

value.label: Figure
value.description: The number as shown, without prefix or suffix (`120`, `4.9`, `24/7`).

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: A small picture above the figure; decorative.

items.description: The figures, in order (Elementor counter, Divi number counter, a Gutenberg columns row of big numbers).

id.description: Anchor id of the section; the heading gets `<id>-title`.

a11y: A description list: each label is the term, each figure its value, so a screen reader reads them as pairs. The section is labelled by its heading.

pattern.summary: row of big numbers with short labels
